<style>
:root{--t:#BA6954;--td:#9C513E;--tl:#E9C3B7;--cream:#F7F2EE;--ink:#141110;--ink2:#1C1817;--mute:#6E6764;--mute2:#9C9490;--line:#E6DFDA;--dline:#2E2826;
--f:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","SF Pro Text","Helvetica Neue",Inter,Arial,sans-serif;--m:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,"JetBrains Mono",monospace}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.5 var(--f);letter-spacing:-.011em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
.mono{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1}
h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.3vw,58px)}
.t{color:var(--t)}
.ic{width:26px;height:26px;display:block}
.dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.dark .mute,.dark p{color:var(--mute2)}
/* nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);color:var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:58px}
.nav .br{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:-.01em}.nav .br img{height:18px}.nav .br em{font-style:normal;color:var(--mute2);font-weight:400}
.nav .lk2{display:flex;gap:22px;margin-left:auto}.nav .lk2 a{text-decoration:none;font-family:var(--m);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.nav .cta{padding:9px 18px;font-size:13.5px}
/* cta */
.cta{white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--t);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;padding:16px 28px;border-radius:99px;letter-spacing:-.01em;transition:background .2s}
.cta span{transition:transform .2s}.cta:hover{background:var(--td)}.cta:hover span{transform:translateX(3px)}
.cta.ghost{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.ctarow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-top:56px}.ctarow small{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}.ctarow.dk small{color:var(--mute2)}
/* chapter label */
.chap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:28px}
.chap .num{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t);border:1px solid currentColor;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:4px}
.chap .lb{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.dark .chap .lb{color:var(--mute2)}
.sec{padding:100px 0}
.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.7fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:64px}
.head p{font-size:21px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--mute);margin:0;letter-spacing:-.015em}
/* hero */
.hero{background:linear-gradient(#fff 62%,var(--cream) 62%);color:var(--ink);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:72px 0 0;text-align:center}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:58%;width:1400px;height:900px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(186,105,84,.10),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.hero .wrap{position:relative}
.hmeta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:28px;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:30px}.hmeta span:first-child{color:var(--t)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,7vw,92px);letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1}
.hero .sub{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:30px;margin-top:24px}
.hero .sub p{font-size:21px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--mute);max-width:600px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.hero .btns{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stage{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:56px auto 0;padding:0 40px}.hero .cta.ghost{color:var(--t);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--t)}
.lap{width:84%;text-align:left}.lap .bw{border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 50px 100px -40px rgba(60,30,20,.45),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.stage .ph{position:absolute;right:40px;bottom:-34px;width:23%;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 40px 90px -20px rgba(60,30,20,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line);max-width:1000px;margin:90px auto 0;position:relative;background:#fff;text-align:left}
.kpis div{padding:26px 26px;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.kpis div:last-child{border-right:0}
.kpis b{display:block;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:700;line-height:1}.kpis span{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mute)}
/* diag */
.flowx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.fx{padding:44px}.fx+.fx{border-left:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--cream)}
.fx .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:40px}
.fx .top b{font-size:80px;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:.8}.fx .top small{font-size:15px;color:var(--mute);margin-left:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.tl{position:relative;display:grid;gap:0}
.tl .nd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.tl .nd i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #bdb3ad;justify-self:center}
.tl .nd b{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.tl .nd span{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
.tl.on .nd{padding:26px 0}.tl.on .nd i{background:var(--t);border-color:var(--t);width:14px;height:14px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(186,105,84,.15)}.tl.on .nd b{font-size:24px}
.fx .note{margin-top:28px;font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--t)}
.assets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0}
.as{padding:40px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.as:first-child{border-left:0}
.as .map{width:100%;max-width:330px;display:block;margin:0 0 18px}
.as .map .dots circle{fill:#E8C9BE}.as .map .arc{fill:none;stroke:var(--t);stroke-width:.6;stroke-dasharray:1.6 1.4}.as .map .city,.as .map .san{fill:var(--t)}.as .map .halo{fill:var(--t);opacity:.18}
.as .big{font-size:84px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:.9}
.as b{display:block;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-top:14px}.as p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--mute);font-size:15.5px}
.as .ph5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;margin-bottom:22px}.as .ph5 i{aspect-ratio:1;background-size:cover;background-position:center 25%}
.leaks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.lk{padding:36px 36px 40px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:36px}.lk:nth-child(3n+1){padding-left:0}.lk:nth-child(3n){border-right:0}
.lk .n{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t)}.lk b{display:block;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1;margin:18px 0 10px}.lk p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:16px}
/* market */
.mkt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--dline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--dline)}
.mk{padding:48px 40px 44px;border-right:1px solid var(--dline)}.mk:first-child{padding-left:0}.mk:last-child{border-right:0}
.mk b{display:block;font-size:clamp(48px,5.4vw,76px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:.9;color:#fff}
.mk b em{font-style:normal;color:var(--t)}
.mk p{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:17px;color:#cfc7c3;max-width:300px}.mk small{display:block;margin-top:18px;font-family:var(--m);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#7b726e;text-transform:uppercase}
.mk small a{color:inherit}
.takeaway{display:flex;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding-top:44px}.takeaway p{font-size:24px;color:#fff;max-width:760px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.3}.takeaway p em{font-style:normal;color:var(--t)}
/* shop */
.shopsec{background:var(--cream)}
.shopsec .bw{box-shadow:0 50px 100px -40px rgba(60,30,20,.4),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.pdpx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 330px;gap:80px;align-items:center;margin-top:100px}
.pdpx .ph{width:330px}
.cas{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.ca{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.ca .n{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t);padding-top:6px}
.ca b{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ca p{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--mute);font-size:16px}
.pdpd{margin-top:80px}
/* funnel */
.fun{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--dline);border-bottom:1px solid var(--dline);position:relative}
.fs{padding:36px 26px 34px;border-right:1px solid var(--dline);position:relative}.fs:first-child{padding-left:0}.fs:last-child{border-right:0}
.fs:not(:last-child):after{content:"→";position:absolute;right:-9px;top:34px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--t);font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:2px 0}
.fs .n{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t)}.fs b{display:block;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:20px 0 4px;color:#fff}.fs em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:14px;color:var(--tl)}
.fs p{font-size:15px;margin:16px 0 22px;line-height:1.45}.fs small{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--m);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#cfc7c3;border:1px solid var(--dline);padding:5px 8px;border-radius:4px}
.fun-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 14px;font-family:var(--m);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7b726e}
.adsx{margin-top:100px}
.adsx .adg{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:0}
.adsx .ad p,.adsx .ad .bl2 span{color:var(--ink)}.adsx .ad .qt{color:#fff}.adsx .ad{color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 40px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.adsx .al{color:var(--mute2)}.adsx .al b{color:#fff}
.adsh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:40px;gap:40px}.adsh h3{font-size:44px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.adsh p{max-width:420px;margin:0;font-size:17px}
/* change */
.chg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.cg{padding:36px 32px 40px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:260px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.cg .n{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t)}.cg b{display:block;font-size:56px;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:.95;font-weight:700}.cg p{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--mute);font-size:16px}
.cg.c2{grid-column:span 2}.cg.w{grid-column:span 2;background:var(--t);color:#fff}.cg.w p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}.cg.w .n{color:#fff}
.cg.im{grid-column:span 2;padding:0;position:relative;color:#fff;background-size:cover;background-position:center 30%}.cg.im:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 30%,rgba(10,6,5,.75))}
.cg.im>div{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:36px 32px;margin-top:auto}.cg.im p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
/* stack */
.stack{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sk{padding:34px 34px 36px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:34px}.sk:nth-child(3n+1){padding-left:0}.sk:nth-child(3n){border-right:0}
.sk .ic{color:var(--t);width:30px;height:30px}.sk b{display:block;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:22px 0 6px}.sk p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:15.5px}
/* plan */
.gantt{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:80px}
.gh{display:grid;grid-template-columns:360px 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.gh div:last-child{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr)}.gh span{font-family:var(--m);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mute);padding:12px 0 12px 8px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.gr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:360px 1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.gl{padding:24px 30px 24px 0}.gl small{font-family:var(--m);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--t)}.gl b{display:block;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:6px 0 4px}.gl p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mute)}
.gt{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr)}.gt i{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.gt span{position:absolute;top:50%;height:30px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:var(--t);border-radius:4px}
.gr:nth-child(odd) .gt span{background:var(--ink)}
.next{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;border:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:80px}
.nx{padding:36px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.nx:first-child{border-left:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff}.nx:first-child p{color:var(--mute2)}
.nx .n{font-family:var(--m);font-size:12px;color:var(--t)}.nx b{display:block;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:16px 0 6px}.nx p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:15.5px}
/* close */
.close{position:relative;color:#fff;min-height:760px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;background-size:cover;background-position:center 12%}
.close:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(14,10,9,.25),rgba(14,10,9,.85) 75%)}
.close .wrap{position:relative;width:100%;padding-bottom:100px}
.close h2{font-size:clamp(44px,6.4vw,88px);letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:.92}
.close .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:40px;margin-top:40px}.close p{font-size:22px;color:#e4dcd8;max-width:500px;margin:0}
.close .btns{display:flex;gap:12px}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:#7b726e;font-family:var(--m);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:26px 0}
footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.src{font-family:var(--m);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#7b726e;margin-top:22px;text-transform:uppercase}
@media (max-width:900px){
 .wrap{padding:0 20px}.sec{padding:80px 0}.nav .lk2{display:none}.nav .wrap{gap:12px}.nav .cta{margin-left:auto}
 .head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:40px}.head p{font-size:18px}
 .hero{padding-top:56px}.hmeta{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px}.hero .sub{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.hero .sub p{font-size:18px}.hero .btns{flex-wrap:wrap}
 .stage{margin-top:50px;padding:0 20px}.lap{width:92%}.stage .ph{right:12px;width:30%}
 .kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin-top:60px}.kpis div{padding:20px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.kpis div:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.kpis b{font-size:32px}
 .flowx,.assets{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fx+.fx,.as{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.fx,.as{padding:28px 22px}.fx .top b{font-size:72px}
 .leaks,.stack{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lk,.sk{padding:26px 0!important;border-right:0}.lk b{font-size:22px}
 .mkt{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mk{padding:32px 0;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dline)}.takeaway{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.takeaway p{font-size:19px}
 .pdpx{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;margin-top:60px}.pdpx .ph{width:260px;margin:0 auto;order:-1}
 .fun{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fs{padding:26px 0;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dline)}.fs:not(:last-child):after{display:none}.fun-h{display:none}
 .adsh{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.adsx .adg{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .chg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.cg{padding:24px 20px;min-height:200px}.cg b{font-size:40px}.cg.w,.cg.im{grid-column:span 2}.cg.im{min-height:300px}
 .gh{display:none}.gr{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gl{padding:20px 0 10px}.gt{height:34px;margin-bottom:18px}
 .next{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nx{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
 .close{min-height:620px}.close .row{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.close .btns{flex-wrap:wrap}.ctarow{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
}
/* browser frame */
.bw{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(60,30,20,.28),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.bw .bar{height:34px;background:#F2EFEC;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:0 14px;position:relative}
.bw .bar i{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#DCD6D1}
.bw .bar span{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11.5px;color:#8a8380;background:#fff;padding:3px 28px;border-radius:6px}
.scaler{position:relative;overflow:hidden}.bw.clip .scaler{max-height:none}.scaler>.shop{width:1280px;transform-origin:0 0;position:absolute;left:0;top:0}
/* phone */
.ph{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(60,30,20,.32),0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06);aspect-ratio:9/18.5;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ph .mb{height:30px;flex:none;background:#F2EFEC;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.ph .mb span{font-size:10.5px;color:#8a8380;background:#fff;padding:2px 22px;border-radius:6px}
.ph .scr{flex:1;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#fff}
.ph .pin{width:375px;transform-origin:0 0;background:#fff}
/* ads */
.adg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;margin-top:44px}
.ad{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 50px -24px rgba(80,40,25,.35)}
.ah{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 13px;font-size:13.5px}.ah small{color:var(--mute);font-size:12px}.ah em{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;color:var(--mute)}
.ah .av{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;padding:2px;background:linear-gradient(45deg,#E9B08F,var(--t))}.ah .av i{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff var(--logo) center/74% no-repeat;border:1.5px solid #fff}
.am{aspect-ratio:4/5;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ab{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover}
.ao{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;color:#fff;padding:22px}.ao.bl{bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(25,12,8,.62))}.ao.tp{top:0;background:linear-gradient(rgba(25,12,8,.5),transparent)}
.ao small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
h6{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:30px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.035em;font-weight:700}
.pill{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px}
.stk{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:18px;width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--t);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.03em;transform:rotate(-10deg)}.stk small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em}
.ab.cr{background:var(--cream);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:22px;gap:22px}
.col{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.col i{flex:1;aspect-ratio:3/4.4;border-radius:10px;background-size:cover;background-position:center 25%}.col b{color:var(--t);font-size:22px}
h6.dk{color:var(--ink);font-size:26px;text-align:center}
.ab.tc{background:var(--t);color:#fff;padding:30px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.qt{font-size:31px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.08}.qt small{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;margin-top:14px;opacity:.85}
.rd{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background-size:cover;background-position:center 25%;align-self:flex-end;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
